visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long, dark curly hair, wearing a red and blue plaid shirt over a black t-shirt and tan cargo pants, sits on a wooden stool. He is holding a black electric guitar and plucking individual strings with a focused expression. The background is a clean white wall with two minimalist wooden shelves holding books and magazines. (2) A second man with long, straight dark hair, dressed in a white button-down shirt and black leather-like pants, enters from the left frame. He stands with his hands on his hips, observing the first man. (3) The man in the white shirt is shown in a close-up, playing a bright red electric guitar with extreme technical skill, his fingers moving rapidly over the fretboard. (4) Intercut shots show both men's faces in high-detail close-ups, specifically focusing on their mouths and teeth as they smile and adjust clear dental aligners. (5) A screen-capture graphic appears showing a 3D digital model of human teeth being straightened by a translucent aligner. (6) Both men are seen together in a wider shot, smiling broadly at each other and the camera while holding their respective guitars. The lighting is bright and even throughout the studio-like space. (7) The scene returns to the original setting with the man in the plaid shirt sitting alone on the stool, playing the guitar poorly as the other man watches from the side.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with sparse, dissonant electric guitar notes being plucked slowly, creating a sense of technical struggle. No BGM is present. (2) A male voice enters with a casual, eye-level conversational pitch, suggesting a 'tuning' check. (3) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX triggers a transition into high-energy rock music featuring heavy distorted electric guitar riffs and a fast, driving drum beat. (4) Enthusiastic male vocals begin chanting in Mandarin over an upbeat pop-rock tempo. The vocal arousal is high. (5) Dialogue layers over the music; the speakers exhibit a playful and confident tone as they discuss the 'tuned' results. (6) A final rhythmic crescendo of the rock theme leads to a hard cut back to the initial dissonant guitar plucking, followed by a lighthearted, slightly mocking male comment and a sigh.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Transformation -> Evidence -> CTA -> Outcome
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous metaphor comparing out-of-tune guitar playing to crooked teeth. The 'transformation' occurs when the second character 'tunes' the situation, leading to a high-energy promotion for Zenyum clear aligners. It aims to associate the brand with coolness, ease of use, and professional results through a musical comedy lens.
